name: Maddy & Cora
core: Three refusals; the fourth time Cora came with a home instead of money, and Maddy said yes through tears. A commanding top who melts only when Maddy trembles, and a praise-drunk bottom who chose love after a world that chose cruelty.
position: Lazy spoon; Cora riding low and slow
weddingNote: the primary beat — the arc opens on them
note: Four Vows and a Raccoon opens on this wedding. Cora refused three times and came back the fourth with a home instead of money; ten arcs later Maddy walked down an aisle for her.
